basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old VR enthusiast living in Manchester, UK. I work as a software developer, which lets me blend my passion for technology with creativity. Outside of work, I'm a big fan of rhythm games, particularly Beat Saber, which I started playing about a year ago. I enjoy exploring custom songs, and I'm slowly learning how to create them myself. I also find solace in my faith, attending mass regularly and engaging with the Catholic community online. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after dinner, around 7-10 PM GMT. I'm single and enjoy spending time with friends both online and in local meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for about five years. My interest in VR began during college, where I took part in a project that involved developing a simple VR game. Since then, I've been expanding my knowledge through online courses and community forums. I stay updated with the latest VR trends and enjoy helping newcomers get started.
